outcome: Persistent Pulmonary Hypertension of the Newborn (PPHN)
cohort: 55 neonates hospitalized due to PPHN at Tata main hospital, Jamshedpur between July 2022 and June 2023.
finding: The incidence of PPHN at the study center was 0.16%, with male gender, abnormal APGAR score at birth, and delivery via cesarean section being highly associated with PPHN neonates.
mod_finding: A significant relationship was reported between PPHN and mode of delivery, with a higher incidence in cesarean section births compared to vaginal deliveries.
